observations.why: A bug or missing-id condition is spoken of AS a pattern — a structural shape that reproduces — framing a technical defect as a recurring template rather than a one-off event.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Two clauses with matched modal-verb-first structure ('Must not…; must…') set in deliberate contrast — prohibition paired with requirement — a parallel construction doing specification work.
